name: @bureaucromancer/lantern-react
description: React components shared between Magic Lantern and StoryEngine's Character Studio.
privateNote: Private until StoryEngine 3.0 starts (plan decision D4).
filesNote: `src` ships beside `dist` because every source map and declaration map names its source as `../src/…`: without it, go-to-definition in a consumer and `node --enable-source-maps` stack traces lead to files that do not exist. Tests and their helpers stay out, as does the build info. tools/pack-shape.test.ts checks the packed list.
dependencyNote: The schema package only, never the client (D4): components take props and callbacks, so StoryEngine can feed them through its own server instead of putting Lantern credentials in the browser.
peerDependenciesNote: A range rather than a pin, unlike every other version here, because a peer names what the host may supply: the component must render with the host's single copy of React (StoryEngine pins 19.2.8 today), and a second copy fails as 'Invalid hook call'. The exact pin lives in devDependencies for this package's own tests.
